comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
There are other story-quests available in the game for all players, but none quite on par with Prince Henrique and Jose's chain.

The ones I know of are:

Fading of glory - Majapahit series
Shadow on the Imperial Capital - Aztec/Ocelotl series
The fake holy woman - Incan Empire/Quipucamayocs series (has unique quest branches for adventure, trade and maritime players; you only need to play through one to reach the end but my understanding is that you can do them all if you like)
Land of the Legendary King - Atlantis series (begins as adventure but does indeed have 3 major story branches, each with cool rewards)
Searching Further for a New World - San Francisco / Justine series
Where to Find the Mysterious Man - Alias series (this chain currently seems to lack links to its remaining quests, I'll fix that if I can)

There's also three job quests which have stories as well.

Delivery Request to the capital of Russia - Millionaire / Sophie
Request from Port Royal - Grand Admiral / Henry Morgan
Meeting a legend - Great Adventurer / John Tradescant (caution: 50+ quests to unlock!)

I probably forgot a few, apologies. And of course, the various Legacy discoveries have stories hidden in them as well. The world of UWO is full of wonders... cheers, hope that gives you and other interested voyagers a lead on some fun new adventures you might not have known were waiting.
